title: The Tumultuous First Day
label: Arc 1
summary: Subaru is pulled into another world with nothing but his phone and bag of groceries. After helping a silver-haired girl search for her stolen insignia, he is killed, and wakes up exactly where he started.
description: Subaru is on his way home from a convenience store when he is suddenly transported to the Kingdom of Lugunica. Sure he must have been given great powers, he is quickly proven wrong when a group of thugs beats him up. A silver-haired girl with amethyst eyes steps in, and Subaru offers to help her track down a thief. When the search ends in a double murder, he finds himself back before it all began, holding a power he calls Return by Death. He resolves to use it to save the girl from the fate she was meant to meet.
keyEvents: Subaru is transported to the Kingdom of Lugunica and beaten by thugs.
A silver-haired girl rescues him, and he offers to help find her stolen insignia.
During the search, both of them are killed by an unknown assailant.
Subaru returns to the moment before they met and resolves to save her.

title: Pride IF
decision: After numerous deaths at the hands of thugs in the capital, Subaru decides not to call for Reinhardt's help and does not ask to be saved.

title: The Turbulent Week
label: Arc 2
summary: Subaru wakes in the mansion of Margrave Roswaal after a near-fatal wound and asks to stay on as a worker. For a few days, life is almost peaceful, but that calm doesn't last.
description: While working as a butler alongside the twin maids Ram and Rem, Subaru unexpectedly finds himself murdered in his sleep. Determined to find the culprit, he uses his loops to earn everyone's trust and hunt down the would-be assassin lurking within the estate.
keyEvents: Subaru awakens at Roswaal Manor and starts working as a butler alongside the twin maids, Ram and Rem.
After experiencing multiple mysterious deaths in his sleep, he discovers that a fatal curse is targeting him.
He traces the source to a nearby village and ventures into the dangerous Mabeast-infested forest alongside Rem and Beatrice.
Subaru confronts the beasts, saves the lost children, and breaks the curse, finally escaping the deadly loop.

title: Wrath IF
decision: Subaru succumbs to paranoia and refuses to trust those around him, due to the accumulated burden of deaths and suffering.

title: Return to the Royal Capital
label: Arc 3
summary: After the mansion, Subaru heads back to the capital to find answers. Instead he hits rock bottom, and has to decide who he is without anyone to lean on.
description: Traveling to the Royal Capital for the start of the Royal Selection, Subaru makes a costly public blunder that strains his relationship with Emilia, leaving him behind to face his deepest insecurities. Supported only by Rem, he must rally rival political camps to face terrifying new threats: the dreaded White Whale and the zealous Witch Cult.
keyEvents: Subaru attends the Royal Selection ceremony in the capital, but a humiliating public outburst leads to a falling out with Emilia.
Left behind in the city, he confronts intense personal despair while news of approaching danger reaches Roswaal Manor.
He forges fragile alliances with the other candidate camps and leads a desperate military campaign to defeat the White Whale.
Subaru confronts the Witch Cult and its Sin Archbishop, ultimately overcoming his hubris and inner demons to save everyone.

title: Sloth IF
decision: When the situation in the capital becomes unbearable, Subaru suggests that he and Rem run away together to the ends of the earth.

title: The Everlasting Contract
label: Arc 4
summary: Subaru and Emilia travel to a hidden village where a trial awaits. Each step forward forces them to face the past they have been avoiding.
description: Retreating to the isolated Sanctuary to find answers, Subaru and Emilia discover a trapped population and a barrier that requires passing ancient Trials to break. As secrets about Roswaal, the Witches, and the Sanctuary come to light, Subaru must battle threats on two fronts: fatal strikes at the manor and a terrifying Great Witchbeast.
keyEvents: Subaru and Emilia travel to the mysterious Sanctuary, finding the villagers trapped behind a ancient magical barrier.
Emilia and Subaru undertake the grueling Trials of the Sanctuary, forcing them to relive and face their deeply buried pasts.
Subaru endures nightmare loops involving lethal attacks at Roswaal Manor and the devastating arrival of the Great Rabbit.
Through trust, strategic coordination, and emotional growth, Subaru unites his allies to defeat the threats and free the Sanctuary.

title: Greed IF
decision: During the trials at the Sanctuary, Subaru forms a contract with Echidna (the Witch of Greed).

title: The Stars That Engrave History
label: Arc 5
summary: A year after the Sanctuary, Emilia's camp is lured to the watergate city of Priestella, where rival camps meet. When the Witch Cult attacks, Subaru must unite them all to save the city.
description: A year of peaceful preparation ends when all five Royal Selection candidates assemble in the Watergate City of Priestella under suspicious pretenses. The gathering turns into an all-out war when multiple Sin Archbishops launch a coordinated siege, forcing Subaru to rally former rivals into a unified defense force to reclaim the city.
keyEvents: The Emilia Camp arrives at the Watergate City of Priestella and unexpectedly reunites with the other four candidate camps.
The Witch Cult launches a surprise attack, with multiple Sin Archbishops seizing control of key city sluice gates and towers.
Subaru uses the city's broadcast system to deliver an inspiring speech that rallies the demoralized citizens and candidates.
The allied forces execute a coordinated counteroffensive across the city to defeat the Archbishops and liberate Priestella.

title: The Corridor of Memories
label: Arc 6
summary: Emilia's camp heads to the Pleiades Watchtower in search of a Sage's knowledge. Amid trials, witchbeasts and a possible traitor, Subaru suffers a sudden loss of memory.

title: Gluttony IF
decision: Instead of choosing acceptance and trust in his allies, Subaru becomes obsessed with restoring his own "self" at any cost.

title: The Land of Wolves
label: Arc 7
summary: Subaru wakes in the jungles of the Vollachia Empire and helps a deposed emperor named Abel reclaim his throne. But signs of a looming disaster begin to appear.

title: Vincent Vollachia
label: Arc 8
summary: The Great Disaster begins. Subaru and his allies retreat from the Imperial Capital, fighting the undead and trying to stop the destruction of the empire.

title: Light of the Nameless Star
label: Arc 9
summary: With Vollachia rebuilding, the Lugunicans start for home. At the Pleiades Watchtower, Subaru lands in his worst predicament yet, captured by Al.

title: The Land of the Lion Kings
label: Arc 10
summary: After Aldebaran's failed scheme, Subaru heads to the Royal Capital to find a Sin Archbishop who holds stolen names and memories, while a hidden conspiracy threatens the Kingdom.

title: Memory Snow
label: OVA
summary: While preparing a date with Emilia, Subaru scouts the nearby village for the perfect spot. Then a sudden cold sweeps the mansion, and the date becomes the least of his worries.

title: The Frozen Bond
label: OVA
summary: In the frozen Elior Forest, young Emilia lives with the great spirit Puck, shunned for her looks. When the Arbitrator Melakuera appears, her right to stay alive is questioned.
